# v1.1.0-dev.57 - The update check works behind TLS inspection

Pre-release off the `dev` branch. Builds on `v1.1.0-dev.56`.

## "Self Signed Certificate In Certificate Chain"

Hitting "Check for updates now" could fail with `self signed certificate
in certificate chain` on a machine that had just finished updating itself
without complaint. Same feed, same URL, and every browser on the box
loads it fine.

The cause is which trust store gets consulted. We were fetching the feed
with Node's `https`, which only trusts the certificate authority list
bundled inside Node itself. Plenty of antivirus products and most
corporate proxies inspect HTTPS by terminating it and re-signing with a
root they install into the Windows certificate store. Windows trusts that
root. Chrome trusts it. Node has never heard of it.

Both the update check and the download go through Electron's network
stack now. That stack is Chromium's, and it validates against the Windows
certificate store the same way every other app on your machine does. We
didn't loosen anything to make this work. Certificates are still verified
in full, just against the store that reflects what your machine actually
trusts.

If you sit behind a proxy, this has a second benefit: the update check
picks up your system proxy settings now instead of ignoring them.

## You Can Select Text Again

The app switches off text selection everywhere so that dragging a window
around the visual editor doesn't leave a trail of blue highlight behind
it. That was a bit indiscriminate. An error message you wanted to paste
into a bug report couldn't be selected either, which is exactly backwards.

Error and status lines are selectable now, and so are the names we read
back to you: profile names, process names, window titles, and the details
in the selection panel and the window editor.

## Window Titles In The Visual Editor

The desktop number badge sat on top of the window title rather than
beside it. On a profile that uses virtual desktops, that little D1 or D2
tag covered the first few characters of every window on the canvas.

The badge sits beside the title now instead of over it, and titles wrap
onto more than one line when the window is tall enough to show them. A
short window still gets a single line ending in an ellipsis, the same as
before. Nothing overlaps anything.

## Install

Auto-updates from dev.53 and later. Otherwise unzip and run.
